about: Release gate for Twoo STEP CAD Toolbox. Run: python tools/golden.py. Limits, not exact numbers (see benchmarks/README.md). Required Notice: Copyright Matthew Armstrong (https://github.com/The-Dorkknight). PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0.
recorded_with: 0.11.0-wip on Linux x86-64, Python 3.13, cadquery-ocp 8.0.1.1.0, numpy 2.5.3, scipy 1.18.1, trimesh 5.2.0

cases.name: box
cases.why: The simplest CAD part: six flat faces. Anything but 6 means flat-face merging broke.

cases.name: stepped
cases.why: Two stacked blocks (two closed bodies): checks that several bodies still come out as valid solids.

cases.name: sphere
cases.why: A smooth ball must become sphere surfaces, not thousands of triangles.

cases.name: cylinder
cases.why: KNOWN WEAKNESS, locked so it can only get better: Classic (the default engine) leaves a 96-sided cylinder as 98 flat strips. The next two cases show Standard and Quick get it right (3 faces).

cases.name: cylinder-auto
cases.why: Standard (the Auto engine) must find the true cylinder: 3 faces.

cases.name: cylinder-ladder
cases.why: Quick (the Ladder engine) must take the lathe route: 3 faces.

cases.name: knob
cases.why: A real mixed part (plane, cylinders, a torus-like round, a ball): the everyday case. 0.10.2 gave 69 faces, 4 facet regions, 0.058 mm worst.

cases.name: knob-quick
cases.why: The same knob through Quick: must stay a valid solid within tolerance.

cases.name: knob-hardpoint
cases.why: The hardpoint STL of the same knob: its labelled faces are used instead of guessing, so 8 faces and no facets.
